_help: AIs the app can use. Add one in Settings > Add an AI, or copy an entry below. type 'ollama' talks to an Ollama server (base_url = its address, e.g. http://10.126.128.116:11434/ for a teammate's server); any other entry is an OpenAI-compatible chat API (base_url ends with /v1/ or similar). key_env = name of the key in .env (null = no key). sleep = seconds between calls. num_ctx = how much text Ollama reads per request (its default is too small for the citation test). think = false turns off the slow 'thinking' of models like qwen3. est_write / est_answer = rough seconds per page / per answer, for the time estimate.

ollama.label: Ollama (your computer or the team server)
